Open to rearm; left fist rotates the tooth.
Right grip or pinch moves the instrument.

Spread hands to zoom in.
Bring hands together to zoom out.

Wave side to side twice to cycle instruments.
Hold the open palm still briefly before repeating.

V: confirm selection. Circle: enamel. Z: pause.
